name: social-media-research-skills
title_zh: 翻完评论区才动手的社媒竞品拆解员
tagline_zh: 别猜了，爆款帖的评论区就是用户替你说完的需求。它把 TikTok、Reddit、X 的离群帖、神评。
tagline_en: Stop guessing. Outlier posts, comment gold, and competitor ad libraries across 7 platforms—dug up in one pass.
desc_en: AI agent skills for social media research. Outlier posts, comment mining, competitor teardowns, ad libraries & trends across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, X, LinkedIn & more. Powered by ScrapeCreators. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI.
why_zh: 不是抓数据，是抓「为什么火」：先定位离群帖，再顺着评论挖情绪和反讽，最后拆竞品广告库。
why_en: It doesn't scrape posts—it mines why they popped: outliers first, then comment sentiment and irony, then competitor ad.
limit_zh: 只覆盖公开数据，登录墙后的私密群组、限流账号看不到；输出是结构化笔记和链接，不生成完整报告。
limit_en: Public data only—no logged-in groups or rate-limited accounts. Outputs structured notes + links, not a polished report. Needs ScrapeCreators API.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Social media teardown that reads comments first
